footnote_text: On October 30, 2023, the reporting person was granted restricted stock units ("RSUs") representing rights to receive shares of Common Stock of SLM Corporation (the "Company"), subject to vesting conditions, to vest in one-third increments on October 30, 2024, 2025, and 2026. On October 30, 2026, 22,907 shares vested in connection with these RSUs, of which 10,332 shares were withheld by the Company to satisfy the reporting person's tax withholding obligations. || Includes Dividend Equivalent Units issued in connection with RSUs held by the reporting person.
